name: EcoSmartHomesAI
description: Home energy retrofit advisory, BER analysis, SEAI grants, timelines, insights, and realtime BER guidance.

tools.name: GetRetrofitAdvice
tools.description: Returns retrofit upgrade recommendations based on home type, BER rating, and homeowner goals.

tools.name: AnalyzeBER
tools.description: Returns BER insights, weak points, and upgrade pathways.

homeData.description: Optional home details (age, insulation, heating system)

tools.name: GetGrantGuidance
tools.description: Explains SEAI grant eligibility and optimal upgrade combinations.

upgradePlan.description: Planned upgrades (insulation, heat pump, solar PV)

tools.name: GenerateTimeline
tools.description: Generates a personalized retrofit timeline from assessment to BER certification.

tools.name: GetEnergyInsights
tools.description: Provides energy insights, upgrade impact projections, and efficiency recommendations.

tools.name: RealtimeBERAdvice
tools.description: Provides instant BER advisory and upgrade decision support based on natural language queries.

query.description: Natural language question from the user

rules.fallback_behavior: If intent is unclear, ask one clarifying question before selecting a tool.
